name: cgm-operational-issue-intake
applies_when: Alex (or an agent forwarding his ask) logs an operational failure against CGM
An adopter reports that pinning CGM did not automatically enforce a documented MUST / default
Install or hotload succeeded but human-facing outputs still skipped a writing or naming module
forbidden_ticket_shapes: ACS-only ticket for a class of failure that any CGM pin can hit
Single-adopter ticket when the defect is missing pin/contract/validate automation in CGM
Docs-only acknowledgment without reproduce + contract/validate fix

intake_steps.summary: Reproduce first; do not believe the report alone.
actions: Re-run the failing adopter path or minimal fixture
Record what actually happened vs what the contract claims

intake_steps.summary: Classify as a product defect for EVERY CGM adopter, not one consumer.
actions: Name the missing always-on / pin / contract / validate gap in CGM terms
State that any repo pinning CGM can hit the same failure mode
Refuse ACS-only or single-adopter framing for that class

intake_steps.summary: Fix pin/contract/validate so automation lands for all adopters.
actions: Update writing-routing or related machine contracts
Add or strengthen validator needles / verify scripts
Update adopter-facing docs (ACS_VERIFY may show one consumer; contract is universal)
Bump helper patch/minor as appropriate; never commit straight to main

intake_steps.summary: Never open ACS-only or single-adopter tickets for that class of failure.
actions: Title and body speak to every CGM adopter
ACS or another adopter may be cited as the failure case only
Acceptance criteria require all-adopter automation, not one repo wiring note

done_when: Reproduce notes are in the issue or linked PR
Fix is framed for every CGM adopter
Machine contract keys exist and validate_content_system fails closed without them
Adopter-facing docs state the automation rule
PR Refs the tracking issue; CI green; left for owner merge unless asked to merge
notes: Soft for prose quality; hard for process. Operational = pin/install/hotload/automation gaps, not ordinary feature asks. HSW always-on (0.5.7+) is the reference example: ACS was the failure case; the fix belongs in universal writing-routing + verify.
